title: Snowrain
description: This datapack introduce rain in the snow
body:
“Why choose between a flurry and a storm?”

SnowRain breaks the vanilla weather cycle by blending the elements. Watch as your biomes transform under a unique mix of rain and snowfall, creating a misty, cold atmosphere. Perfect for players who want their world to feel more unpredictable and immersive.

Key Details:

    Blended precipitation effects.

    Natural lightning occurrences.

    Simple "plug-and-play" installation.
